question: On whom should the officiant meditate while making the offering at the end of svāhā?
premises: The offering is made at the conclusion of svāhā.
The mantra-deity is the object of meditation.
inference: One should offer at the end of svāhā while meditating on the mantra-deity.
plain_english: At the end of svāhā, one should offer while meditating on the deity of the mantra.
